comments.text:
What surprised you most about life in Afghanistan — the difficult choices families make to survive, the restrictions on women's lives, or the traditions that continue despite years of hardship?
Share your thoughts respectfully below. We'd love to hear your perspective. 🌍

comments.author: @SofiaMalik-j8t
